items.title: Zcash’s landmark NU7 upgrade goes live, speeding up private payments
items.summary: NU7 cuts the target time between blocks to 25 seconds, reduces the work wallets must do to find private payments and sets aside fees for future miners.

items.title: Hyperliquid treasury firm seeking U.S. regulatory nod as a domestic futures platform
items.summary: The company said it's trying to establish a U.S. "futures commission merchant" with full compliance for activity with U.S. clients, though the timing is uncertain.

items.title: Bitcoin developer proposes ‘landmines’ to make quantum thieves lose their own BTC
items.summary: Anyone trying to move vulnerable bitcoin would have to put up matching collateral, giving prepared owners a chance to take both.

items.title: U.S. Justice Department assembles force to shield against foreign AI threats
items.summary: The new DOJ task force will aid the recently designated U.S. "SI Force" by warding off bad actors backed by other nations, criminal groups or corporate fraud.

items.title: Bitcoin tumbles to $76,000 as collapsing AI trade drags stocks sharply lower
items.summary: The post-election rally quickly reversed as AI stocks plunged, but cryptocurrencies held up relatively better despite a $1 billion liquidation wave.

items.title: What is TraderTraitor, the hacking squad behind the $6.3 billion Binance heist?
items.summary: The hacking group has been behind some of the crypto industry's most recent high-profile thefts.

items.title: Standard Chartered and SBI back crypto insurer Soter as funding reaches $23.5 million
items.summary: Soter also received backing of 500 BTC and 2000 ETH, worth another $43 million at current prices.

items.title: Crypto for Advisors: Where investors stake crypto shapes how much of the reward they keep
Gate CEO says crypto exchanges must prove they can survive a hack like Binance’s
items.summary: Lin Han says Gate holds enough assets in cold storage to cover customer balances even if its hot wallets are emptied. An independent audit is underway.

items.title: Kraken parent Payward and its clients buy AAVE tokens in DeFi investment push
items.summary: The investment follows talks first reported by CoinDesk in June that included a proposed equity stake in Aave Group.

items.title: Solana’s Shanghai event halted over unauthorized promotion: Report
items.summary: Solana’s promotional campaigns through domestic entities allegedly violated China’s crypto-related restrictions, an unidentified PBOC official told China’s Financial News.

items.title: Binance hackers had 8 weeks of access before $6.3B exploit, Security Alliance estimates
items.summary: The cybersecurity company flagged similar multi-stage intrusion patterns behind other high-profile crypto heists, including the $388 million Bitget hack.

items.title: Bitcoin holds $75K as AI regulation fears see KOSPI halted after 8% crash
items.summary: Bitcoin consolidated as fears over US AI regulation spread to Asia, causing South Korea to announce measures to calm stock-market volatility.

items.title: Greece approves 10% tax on crypto gains starting in 2027
items.summary: Greece has approved a 10% tax on cryptocurrency gains starting in 2027, with an exemption for investors whose annual net gains do not exceed 500 euros.

items.title: GOPAX halts crypto trading, withdrawals to move all assets to cold storage
items.summary: South Korea’s GOPAX suspended trading, deposits and standard withdrawals after a hacking threat, with manual withdrawals available through support.

items.title: Binance’s $6.3B hack leaves questions over hot wallet safeguards
items.summary: Experts say blockchain records show repeated wallet drains but cannot establish Binance’s internal signing controls or transaction limits.

items.title: Zcash NU7 upgrade goes live, leaves 12,224 ZEC stranded in Sprout pool
items.summary: Zcash’s NU7 upgrade has rendered about $15 million in legacy Sprout funds unspendable, although a future network upgrade could potentially restore access.

items.title: Hyperliquid Strategies seeks futures registration for perps
items.summary: The HYPE treasury company spent $785 million on tokens during the quarter and wants to bring Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures to the US.

items.title: Bitcoin, Ether ETFs post $530M outflows as election gains evaporate
items.summary: US spot Bitcoin and Ether ETFs shed a combined $530 million Thursday as Bitcoin fell below $76,000 and US stocks tumbled.

items.title: Chainalysis says breach exposed password hashes and live tokens
items.summary: Chainalysis disclosed password hashes and live tokens were exposed after initially reporting only non-sensitive customer data was accessed.

items.title: Former FBI Agent Pleads Guilty to Stealing $2.5M in Crypto From 35 Investigations
items.summary: Patrick Yaroch drained wallets using credentials the FBI had collected, then asked ChatGPT for advice on starting a new life in Europe.

items.title: Zcash's NU7 Upgrade Goes Live, Recycling 60% of Fees to Fund Future Block Rewards
items.summary: The Network Sustainability Mechanism will reissue removed ZEC from 2031 within the 21 million cap, as the community debates its dev fund.

items.title: Claude Gets Personal Finance—Anthony Pompliano Accuses Anthropic of Copying His Startup
items.summary: Anthropic's Claude finance assistant analyzes spending from linked accounts in the U.S., and Anthony Pompliano has a big problem with it.

items.title: Bitcoin Fixes This? Paraguay President Resigns After Bank Lockout Hits 60% of Country
items.summary: Ueno’s collapse trapped millions of Paraguayan depositors and triggered a president’s resignation, reviving Bitcoin’s argument for self-custody.

items.title: OpenAI Promises to Foot AI’s Power Bill After Voter Revolt. Who Enforces It?
items.summary: OpenAI wants to ease the backlash against AI campuses with promises on electricity, water and secrecy. Its new compact raises a tougher question: Who would make the company comply?

items.title: DOJ Creates 'Super Intelligence' Task Force to Guard Against AI Abuse
items.summary: Led by two senior DOJ officials, the Super Intelligence Task Force will target misuse by foreign governments, criminal groups and fraudsters—while pushing AI developers to tighten internal controls so their systems “beha

items.title: Mercado Bitcoin Said Its Hack Was Contained, But Blockchain Data Tells a Different Story
items.summary: Fresh forensic analysis traces $48.6 million across 11 blockchains and finds thousands of customer deposit addresses drained hours after the Brazilian exchange said it had stopped the breach on Monday.

items.title: Zcash Upgrade Could Lock $16 Million in Crypto Forever
items.summary: Zcash's latest upgrade promises faster transactions, but thousands of coins remain in an aging privacy system that will soon stop accepting withdrawals, potentially leaving their owners empty-handed.

items.title: OpenAI Found 948 Linux Security Flaws—And Figured Out How to Exploit Them
items.summary: An automated OpenAI system produced working exploits and draft fixes at roughly $1,279 per flaw, raising new questions about how cheaply AI can find holes in critical software at scale.

items.title: Trump-Backed American Bitcoin Turns a Profit as Bitcoin Rise Lifts Books
items.summary: The Hut 8-backed miner reversed a second-quarter loss, driven largely by a $197 million gain on its Bitcoin holdings.
